protocol.scope: All 117 v16 template/dtype/shape combinations. Independent cold compilation in the personal P800 v18 image. First fully successful measurement per case; all failed attempts retained.
protocol.selection: Two primary randomized forward/reverse rounds of 128 synchronized ordinary calls per public route. Two additional matched rounds add the direct original module. Stable threshold is 3% in both rounds. Rank on primary public samples; label direct wins only using the secondary series.
protocol.final_wall: Median of 32 separately measured synchronized ordinary calls. Speedup = direct eager median / selected public median. Original module, warmed public module and same inputs. This is distinct from GPU-event batch speedup.
protocol.device: GPU batch numbers cover 7 batches of 40 calls and include submission gaps. Per-candidate calibrated GPU replay times are available in chosen.candidates[].captured_us.
protocol.launcher: Isolated experiment forces SDNN only on finite inputs, outside the production decision. Both arms call the identical binary with new output and the current stream. Report paired differences of synchronized time per randomized block.
protocol.layer_breakdown: 64 paired samples after warm-up on the same inputs. Bare plan includes the call, launch and allocation. Positive delta means slower.
